The [[Shifala]] homeworld of [[Carreras Major]] had a '''capital city''' as of [[138 ABY]]. It contained the [[Governor's palace (Carreras Major)|governor's palace]], which was built into the heart of the city. One known resident was [[Biala]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Carreras system/Legends|Carreras system]].
